versions.grouping_at_time: Section 20 — Air Transportability, Airdrop, Mission/Test Equipment and Cargo/Payload Safety
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the air vehicle provides the capability to safely recover a towed jumper. Standard: The air vehicle has a capability to retrieve a hung paratrooper without injury using onboard equipment operated by the available aircrew. On-board equipment is readily available to permit this operation without extensive delay. Method of Compliance: Flight testing results demonstrate the capability exists for a single aircrew member (unless otherwise specified) to readily retrieve a maximum weight towed mannequin plus the maximum towed parachute bag(s) minus one, using the onboard equipment. Flight testing results encompass a range of dummy weights to verify no adverse effects during retrieval into the aircraft exit way.
